title: RDW–MCHC interaction did not improve cross-cycle prediction of elevated hsCRP beyond additive blood-count measures
abstract: Adding a centered RDW-by-MCHC interaction to a nonlinear additive conventional CBC/demographic model did not establish better cross-cycle prediction of hsCRP >3 mg/L in independent NHANES adult samples (2015–2016 n=5043; 2017–2018 n=4827). Weighted Brier delta +0.00001461; target-PSU 95% interval [-0.00004664, +0.00008154], joint-refit interval [-0.00005706, +0.00029148]. Frozen-model confirmation, author checks, clean rerun, public inputs, code and uncertainty accompany this scoped negative result.
